description.value: Greenwood Country Inn is a chalet-style bed and breakfast in Pemberton, BC, operated by Margit de Haan, who brings over 20 years of international hospitality experience and speaks both English and German. The inn offers four individually themed guest rooms — Dove Tail, Humming Bird, Love Bird, and Dream Suite — featuring mountain and valley views from multiple decks. It sits about 25 minutes from the Whistler/Blackcomb area, making it a potential rest stop for cyclists travelling through the Pemberton Valley.
